item.title: ‘Be the change’: Facilitator program strengthens SAPR support across 916th ARW
item.description: The 916th Air Refueling Wing is encouraging Airmen to volunteer as Sexual Assault Prevention and Response (SAPR) and suicide prevention facilitators, a role that helps strengthen resilience, increase awareness of resources and support fellow service members across the wing.

item.title: Greco, Bradshaw, Stoll named Airmen of the Year for Kentucky Air Guard
item.description: Senior Airman Ethan Greco, Staff Sgt. Lucas Bradshaw and Senior Master Sgt. Dallas Stoll will be honored during a banquet in Louisville, Kentucky, March 14, 2026, as the Kentucky Air National Guard’s Airmen of the Year for 2026.

item.title: Pence selected as Kentucky Air Guard’s top first sergeant for 2026
item.description: Master Sgt. Josh Pence has been selected as the Kentucky Air National Guard’s First Sergeant of the Year for 2026 and will be honored at the Airman’s Gala banquet in Louisville, Kentucky, March 14, 2026.

item.title: 104th Fighter Wing Explosive Ordnance Disposal team conducts monthly detonation training
item.description: BARNES AIR NATIONAL GUARD BASE, Mass. – The Civil Engineering Squadron Explosive Ordnance Disposal Flight with the 104th Fighter Wing conducted their monthly training detonations March 8, 2026, to ensure the flight’s training and unit readiness.

item.title: Ebbing ANGB Senior Enlisted Leader Retires After 37 Years of Service
item.description: Chief Master Sgt. Ronald J. Bobbitt, Senior Enlisted Leader for the 188th Force Support Squadron at Ebbing Air National Guard Base, has retired following a distinguished 37-year career in the U.S. Air Force and Air National Guard on March 8, 2026.

item.title: Guard Officer Retires After 32 years; Has No Plans to Give Spouse’s Liver Back
item.description: After more than three decades of service to the state and nation, Lt. Col. Justin Wilkerson, Deputy Joint Operations Officer of the Illinois National Guard, has retired. Wilkerson served in the military for 32 years. His career is marked by leadership, operational deployments, and personal resilience. item.title: Desert Storm, Wisconsin National Guard vet recalls training time at McCoy, supporting operation
item.description: Operation Desert Storm and 107th Maintenance Company veteran Duane Streeck with the 88th Readiness Division was one of the visitors Feb. 26 during the Desert Storm History Day event at the Fort McCoy History Center.

item.title: Cyber Champion defends Digital Frontlines
item.description: Leaders like U.S. Army Chief Warrant Officer 3 Eugy Zermeno are setting the standard — combining technical skill, bold leadership, and an unwavering commitment to service.

item.title: 35 Years Ago: Wisconsin National Guard’s 107th Maintenance Company one of many units deployed from Fort McCoy for Desert Shield-Desert Storm
item.description: During Operation Desert Shield/Operation Desert Storm 35 years ago between August 1990 and March 1991, nine Wisconsin National Guard units deployed to support the operations to respond to Iraq invading Kuwait. The 107th Maintenance Company was among those nine Wisconsin National Guard units.

item.title: 2d TSB honors 2025 Employees of the Year
item.description: The 2d Theater Signal Brigade announces its Employees of the Year for 2025, celebrating the outstanding dedication and contributions of three exemplary team members from across its battalions.
